definitions.full: H1031. Beth Choglah חָגְלָה בֵּית proper name, of a location ( place of partridge ) in Benjamin, on border of Judah Josh 15:6 ; ׳בֵּיתחֿ 18:19 , 21 , modern ±Ain „ajla (or Qaƒr „ajla compare Rob & Di Gen 50:11 ) Rob BR i. 544 Bd Pal 172 .
definitions.rootNote: from 1004 and the same as 2295 ; house of a partridge;

occurrences.englishText: The border went up to Beth Hoglah, and passed along by the north of Beth Arabah; and the border went up to the stone of Bohan the son of Reuben.
The border passed along to the side of Beth Hoglah northward; and the border ended at the north bay of the Salt Sea, at the south end of the Jordan. This was the south border.
Now the cities of the tribe of the children of Benjamin according to their families were Jericho, Beth Hoglah, Emek Keziz,
